description: Verified monthly means for a CO-OPS water-level station, one row per station-month: the month's highest and lowest water, its tidal datums (MHHW, MHW, MSL, MTL, MLW, MLLW, DTL), tidal ranges (GT, MN, DHQ, DLQ), and lunitidal intervals (HWI, LWI) — the record a sea-level or tidal-range trend over years to decades is read from. Heights are relative to the requested datum in the requested units. A value CO-OPS publishes no figure for is omitted rather than reported as zero; a Great Lakes station carries only highest, msl, and lowest. A range may span up to 73,000 days, checked before the call, and CO-OPS verifies this product monthly, for the prior month, so a window ending on or after the first day of the prior month can fail with verified_data_lag. A range whose months fit the response budget is returned whole; a longer one returns the leading months, with rows_matched, rows_returned, and next_offset reporting how many matched and which offset reaches the rest. Use noaa_marine_find_stations with types=["water_level"] first to resolve a station name or location to a station ID.

begin_date.description: Start date, YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "19750101" or "1975-01-01". The month it falls in is the first month returned.

datum.description: Datum the monthly heights are referenced to. MLLW (default) is the US nautical chart datum; MHHW, MHW, MTL, MSL, and MLW are the other tidal planes. NAVD is NAVD88 and reads only where the station has an NAVD88 tie. STND is the station's own datum and reads any station. IGLD and LWD apply at Great Lakes stations only, which carry no tidal datum, and CRD at Columbia River stations only. A datum this station does not carry comes back as datum_unavailable.

end_date.description: End date (inclusive), YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "20251231" or "2025-12-31". The month it falls in is the last month returned.

limit.description: Maximum months to return on this page, for a caller that wants fewer than the response budget allows. Omit for the largest page that fits; a value larger than the budget allows does not widen the page.

offset.description: Month offset into the matched series, for reading a range whose months do not fit one response. 0 (default) starts at the first month; pass the next_offset from a previous call to continue. An offset past the last month returns an empty page rather than an error.

station_id.description: CO-OPS water-level station ID (numeric, e.g. "9447130" for Seattle). Obtain from noaa_marine_find_stations with types=["water_level"].

units.description: Unit system for the heights: english = feet; metric = meters. The lunitidal intervals are hours either way.

name: noaa_marine_get_monthly_means

begin_date.description: Start of the requested range as sent to CO-OPS, YYYYMMDD.

datum.description: Datum the heights are referenced to — echoed for correct interpretation.

end_date.description: End of the requested range as sent to CO-OPS, YYYYMMDD.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: begin_date/end_date is not a real calendar date or begin_date is after end_date. `date_range_exceeded`: The requested range spans more than 73,000 days, the CO-OPS limit for monthly means. `station_not_found`: CO-OPS rejected the station ID as not a valid station. `datum_unavailable`: The station does not carry the requested datum — a Great Lakes station has no tidal datum, and IGLD and LWD apply at Great Lakes stations only. `verified_data_lag`: CO-OPS returned no months for a window ending on or after the first day of the prior month, which it may not have verified yet. `no_data`: CO-OPS returned no months for a window ending before the prior month — the station has no monthly means for it. `upstream_throttled`: CO-OPS answered the monthly-mean request with HTTP 403, which it returns for about two minutes while it throttles a burst of requests from one address. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

months.description: One row per station-month in the requested range, oldest first — the whole matched series when it fits one response, otherwise the leading page starting at offset. rows_matched and next_offset report what a page left behind.

items.description: One station-month of tidal datums and extremes.

dhq.description: Mean diurnal high water inequality, MHHW − MHW (DHQ), in the requested units. A difference between two tidal planes, so it is the same under every datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

dlq.description: Mean diurnal low water inequality, MLW − MLLW (DLQ), in the requested units. A difference between two tidal planes, so it is the same under every datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

dtl.description: The month's mean diurnal tide level (DTL), in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

gt.description: Great diurnal range, MHHW − MLLW (GT), in the requested units. A difference between two tidal planes, so it is the same under every datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

highest.description: The month's highest observed water level, in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

hwi.description: Greenwich high water interval (HWI), in hours. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

inferred.description: CO-OPS inferred-data code for the month, exactly as CO-OPS sends it. Observed values include "0", "1", and "11" — a code, not a boolean.

lowest.description: The month's lowest observed water level, in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

lwi.description: Greenwich low water interval (LWI), in hours. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

mhhw.description: The month's mean higher high water (MHHW), in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

mhw.description: The month's mean high water (MHW), in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

mllw.description: The month's mean lower low water (MLLW), in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

mlw.description: The month's mean low water (MLW), in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

mn.description: Mean range of tide, MHW − MLW (MN), in the requested units. A difference between two tidal planes, so it is the same under every datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

msl.description: The month's mean sea level (MSL), in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

mtl.description: The month's mean tide level (MTL), in the requested units relative to the requested datum. Omitted when CO-OPS publishes no value for the month.

next_offset.description: Offset to pass as offset on the next call, or null when this page reaches the last matched month. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

notice.description: What this page of the monthly series covers and how to reach the next page.

page_offset.description: Month offset this page starts at, echoed from the request. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

rows_matched.description: Months the requested range matched, before the page was cut. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

rows_returned.description: Months this page carries — the length of months. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

station_id.description: Station ID echoed from the request — for chaining.

station_name.description: Station name as returned by CO-OPS.

truncated.description: True when this page stops short of the last matched month, so further months remain at next_offset. False on the final page and on a page past the end. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

title: Get Monthly Means
